searchText: Hi everyone! I'm reaching out from the SilentSwap team. Our founder, is looking to connect with researchers and engineers focused on execution privacy and zero-knowledge tooling. We’ve been working with a hybrid ZK/TEE architecture for non-custodial privacy routing and real-time sanctions screening. We’d love to discuss technical design patterns, ZK proof efficiency, and potential R&D synergies with the PSE team. What is the best channel or way to connect with researchers here? Thank you
